notes.subject: קמט
notes.rationale: Root קמט (shrink/shrivelled) i save kamap long Tanakh hia tasol — 'krusim mi olgeta' i holim piksa bilong skin i krus.

notes.subject: כחשי
notes.rationale: כחש i min 'nogat mit' (emaciation) na tu 'tok giaman' (hypocrisy) — ol save tok 'leanness' o 'falsehood'; 'nogat-mit' i holim bodi-piksa bilong Job.

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Hebtru i no gat pronoun bilong waines; Tok Pisin i nidim ⟨em⟩.

translation: Na yu krusim mi olgeta, ⟨em⟩ i kamap waines; na nogat-mit bilong mi i kirap long mi, long pes bilong mi em i tok agen.
